scenario_title: Hotfix patch serialised requests with a global lock
title: Latency and timeouts on coord-svc

detection.alert: coord-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on coord-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] coord-svc 2026-06-09 05:33-08:33: coord-svc: 195 of 261 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-09 05:33 and 2026-06-09 08:33 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 5 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.
error_templates: request timed out after 30000 ms (lock contention)
request waited <*> ms for the global lock
Interrupted while waiting for message on queue

_templates.macro: Hotfix patch {version_to} of {svc} fixed a race by adding a global lock; every request then waited on that lock and latency exploded under load.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) wraps the whole request in one global lock.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; fix the race with a per-key lock at {file}:{line}; load-test hotfixes before prod.

rca.macro: Hotfix patch v1.10.1 of coord-svc fixed a race by adding a global lock; every request then waited on that lock and latency exploded under load.
rca.micro: coord/server/NIOServerCnxn.java:91 (NIOServerCnxn.doIO) wraps the whole request in one global lock.
rca.remediation: Roll back coord-svc v1.10.1 -> v1.10.0; fix the race with a per-key lock at coord/server/NIOServerCnxn.java:91; load-test hotfixes before prod.

action_items: Add a regression test covering NIOServerCnxn.doIO (coord/server/NIOServerCnxn.java).
Alert on the error signature `request timed out after 30000 ms (lock contention)`.
